placements.title: The index hands a reader the whole context around a statement, never a lone statement
placements.frame: Does this expression keep a frame, its statements and the call or narrative around them together as the unit a reader sees, or does it cut a statement or frame loose from its context?
placements.why: The unit-of-expand rules, the claim that a frame is a lens and not a carrier of meaning, and the recall results measured at the unit of expand all say that meaning and relevance are judged on whole context. The recall results are evidence for that theme, not a leaf of their own.

placements.title: Stand on prior work and say what is actually new before building something of our own
placements.frame: Does this expression build on a mature existing component or earlier work, and if it rolls something new, what is it actually adding?
placements.why: The shoulders-of-giants rule and the extend-first rules file are the general posture. The retrieval ruling, with a hand-rolled engine retiring if the textbook stack ties, applies that posture.
consulted: graph structure: empty, no existing leaf to reuse

placements.title: Steering is novel and ours; recall and precision belong to a mature engine
placements.frame: Does this expression keep steering separate from recall, and does it take recall and precision from engine primitives rather than from the steering machinery?
placements.why: The split of steering from recall, with the hand-rolled layer conceded as the weak link and engines supplying primitives but not domain decisions, is a subject future retrieval work will keep feeding. It is a specific case of the extend-first posture, so it sits under it.
consulted: Narrative_ExtendExistingWorkBeforeRollingOwn: minted in this response as the hub

placements.title: A design is tested against a judged oracle before it is exported or built in
placements.frame: Does this expression hold a design back until it has been tested, and against what reference is it scored: production's own output or an independently judged set?
placements.why: The export gate (nothing passed on as a build input until tested), the rejection of production as the scoring target in favour of a judged set, the test results read against it, and the concession that the hand-rolled layers were built without an oracle all say a design must be proven on an oracle first.

placements.title: An output cap is a circuit breaker for runaway behaviour, never a way to shorten replies
placements.frame: Does this expression use an output cap only as a rarely tripped safeguard, or as a stand-in for asking for a shorter reply in the prompt?
placements.why: The circuit-breaker rule, written into llm-calls.md and illustrated by one model running away uncapped while another never hit a limit, is a standing subject for how LLM calls are built.
